scope: LP64 engine executes real x32 glibc programs under an x32-enabled Linux kernel. Native library/pthread workers use four-byte controls and long-mode stack/syscall layouts. Native calls preserve eight 64-bit scalar arguments/results and memory syscalls preserve 64-bit mmap file offsets. Actual callee-exec, independent pthread release and retained-image recovery pass under KVM and TCG; native, sanitizer and ARM64 regressions remain passing. No universal compatibility claim.
